substack.email_subject: Retired at 58. Then he built one of the world's largest eye hospitals.
substack.note:
Retired by the government at 58, with fingers bent by arthritis, an eye surgeon opened an 11-bed hospital in Madurai and asked a strange question: if a hamburger chain can serve millions the same quality, quickly and cheaply, why can't a hospital do that for eyesight?

Kindness decides what problem you solve. Only a good system decides how many people you reach.
